title: Count the spanning trees of the two-by-three grid

source.citation: Szabolcs Horvát et al., IGraph/M: graph theory and network analysis for Mathematica, arXiv:2209.09145; IGSpanningTreeCount tests at szhorvat/IGraphM commit 8de23ab6b2dcab448ba13bffe4c3a864c54927e7

translation.notes: The source test expects fifteen spanning trees for a 2-by-3 grid. Noether checks it using the exact reduced-Laplacian determinant.
